notes.title: Chocolat Rush v1.0.3 Update!
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35393685/d734779fe1019093c61740cd0db7d204069b0de8.png

Here's the first update for the Chocolat Rush!

New feature
1. Added a new game-mode "nightmare mode"

Game improvement
1. Set language to game language on first run
2. Improved translation
3. Sound Improvement
4. Stabilized the Games

Bug fixes
1. Fixed the problem of stiffness in the shooting of a giant chocolat.
2. Fixed problems where my record on the Leaderboard Friends tab was not highlighted
3. Local related bug stabilization
4. Stabilization of enemy alerts
5. Fixed Achievement issues
6. Other minor bugs fixed

We'll be back with a new update.
Until then.. have a sweet shot!
